title: Orthogonality Lab
description: Interactive companion to Chapter 5 of Leon, Linear Algebra with Applications: scalar products and projections, the four fundamental subspaces, least squares, norms and inner products, orthonormal bases, Gram–Schmidt and QR, orthogonal polynomials.
lede: Right angles make linear algebra easy. Project one vector on another, see the row space and null space meet at 90°, fit data by least squares and watch the residual stay orthogonal to the columns, compare norms, read coordinates in an orthonormal basis, and run Gram–Schmidt one column at a time.
